description: One object as the storage service's list route answers it, captured from a real response (caller-rules.test.ts), and one folder. The contract for every storage server: the Node service checks its answers against this file, @supatype/client builds its fixture from it, and supatype-server's local objstore keeps a byte-identical copy at internal/objstore/testdata/node-list-entry.json. A list answers a folder's direct children: one `folder` entry per subfolder, then the files in it as `entry`, each named relative to the folder. `nullable` names the fields of a file entry that may be null instead of the kind shown; a folder entry is null in every field but `bucket_id` and `name`.
